description:
BROE auctioneers are delighted to present this 3 bed semi detached family home to the market in the highly sought after Cherrywood Drive. No. 177 is brought to the market in great condition with well-appointed accommodation and spacious room proportions, which boast numerous advantages. The accommodation consists of extended entrance hallway, lounge, kitchen/dining room and French doors to private walled low maintenance south facing rear garden. Upstairs there are three bedrooms and main family bathroom. Just a short stroll from Clondalkin Village and close to an abundance of amenities including shops, schools, and leisure facilities and only moments away from the M50 motorway and Luas light railway, which enables easy access to all parts of the country. This superb property has a lot to offer, and early viewing is recommended.

Contact BROE auctioneers to register your interest.
